items.title: UE companion plugin
items.detail: Shipped. Pairing, Send to Unreal, real assets, learning in the editor, and stacking into one Create request.

items.title: Mac signing
items.detail: The macOS download is unsigned. Notarizing it needs an Apple certificate Johno has not added. Signing stays deferred.

items.title: Public community repo
items.detail: Shipped in 1.18.0. The Community tab lists packs from Johno222222222/ue5-systems-training-tool-packs. Local .bbpack import still works.

items.title: Real assets
items.detail: Shipped in 1.14.0. Create in Unreal makes a data table, a primary data asset, and a Blueprint stub in the open project.

items.title: Learning in the editor
items.detail: Shipped in 1.15.0. The Architect panel shows WHY notes, checks challenges on the created assets, and can search the glossary.

items.title: Linux packages
items.detail: AppImage and deb are built next to the Windows installer. Linux and macOS stay unsigned. The Windows installer is Azure-signed.

items.title: Module stacking
items.detail: Shipped in 1.16.0. Stack saved systems into one plugin, share interfaces and gameplay tags, and list conflicts before Create in Unreal.

items.title: Learn, programs, and courses
items.detail: Shipped in 1.17.0. Big Picture and a two-level quiz, genre tracks with a final exam, and shorter courses.

items.title: Glossary and event-graph nodes
items.detail: Shipped in 1.18.0. More lesson terms, and the gameplay nodes those tracks use, with Simulate, Blueprint text, and UE 5.8 C++.

items.title: Final Version 1 refinements
items.detail: Shipped in 1.19.0. Shuffled quizzes with true/false mixed in, clickable C++ lines with built-in notes, a shared glossary popover, program and course lessons on one engine, self-scored blanks, a welcome tour, a bug-report link, and a release check.

items.title: Editable graded C++ and node graph assignments
items.detail: Version 2. Assignments you edit in the C++ and event graph, scored by the app. 1.19.0 assignments are self-scored with a reveal toggle.

items.title: System-specific Programs
items.detail: Version 2. Saved lesson packs return here as programs tied to a system. The 1.19.0 Programs page hides that list and keeps the saved data.
